channel.description: Who is cancelling: `staff` (someone operating the hub, the default) or `customer` (the client through an external channel, subject to allow_customer_cancellation and cancellation_notice_hours, and bound to say who they are with `customer_id`).

customer_id.description: Who is asking, on the `customer` channel (appointments#140): the id of that client in `customers`, as the external channel resolved them (the WhatsApp automation looks the client up by phone before listing anything). The cancellation is refused when the appointment belongs to somebody else. MANDATORY whenever `channel` is `customer`, and applied by the handler rather than here: it is a rule about two fields at once, decided against the appointment row this schema cannot see. The staff channel never sends it.
